hypothesis: Author points 7-8: energy use writes a trace onto space that is readable later. Through the established gravity channel (G = kappa T, Gdot = 0), the Sun's energy use (luminosity plus solar wind) lowers its gravitational parameter at d(GM)/dt / GM = -(L/(c^2 M) + wind fraction), and the planetary orbits record it. No UET-specific parameter enters; the psi channel is bounded separately (T005).

prediction_method.description: predicted = -(L/(c^2 M) + wind fraction) with L and GM from IAU 2015 B3, M = GM/G (CODATA 2018 G), Julian year; sigma_pred = wind sigma; z = |measured - predicted| / sqrt(sigma_meas^2 + sigma_pred^2)

fixed_parameters: solar wind fraction 2.0e-14 per year with assumed 1-sigma 1.0e-14
IAU 2015 nominal L and GM; measured value exactly as registered
pass_criterion: PASS if z <= 2. The Result must also report z for the null hypothesis 'energy use leaves no gravitational trace' (prediction 0) and for radiation alone.
fail_criterion: FAILED if z > 3; INCONCLUSIVE if 2 < z <= 3, or if the registered values disagree with the journal texts.
note: Disclosure: drafted after reading the measured value and the inputs; a rough hand estimate puts z near 1.5 (PASS), so the outcome is effectively known. The script was not run. This test checks author points 7-8 through standard physics and cannot distinguish UET from general relativity. The wind uncertainty is the card's own assumption; the measurement window (2011-2015) is near solar maximum, while the wind value is quoted for solar minimum. Approved by the author on 2026-11-10 as drafted, without a journal cross-check.
